recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a redundant DetectedIssue example to core unless the CDS work group reverses the current DetectedIssue/GuidanceResponse/OperationOutcome boundary; any QI-Core profile work would belong outside this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-15925 was a Published/Persuasive CDS issue from the STU3/QI-Core ballot context requesting an example warning for cases where missing patient data prevents a reliable decision-support conclusion, with resolution text suggesting a DetectedIssue profile/example for QI-Core.
initial_application: The issue was applied to core by commit 993f6deef4787c65d3206ac5d8da460a0c634ad4, which added source/guidanceresponse/guidanceresponse-additional-data-example.xml and updated GuidanceResponse example text, followed by commit 29562deafaf5f66a0cf9273c94719acf7bda7c40 fixing the example-list entry. PR HL7/fhir#2834 merged those changes and explicitly lists J#15925 as adding a GuidanceResponse example requesting additional data.
additional_context: GuidanceResponse and DetectedIssue are active current-build resources. GuidanceResponse defines data-required/data-requested statuses and dataRequirement for missing or desired data. DetectedIssue boundaries state that insufficient data and other business-rule failures are conveyed with OperationOutcome rather than DetectedIssue. Later no-change issue FHIR-39407 supports using GuidanceResponse for completion/additional-data status rather than adding DetectedIssue structure.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current active source includes GuidanceResponse/additional-data-example with status data-required and lists it in the GuidanceResponse examples.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change CDS issue confirms GuidanceResponse already supports completion/additional-data status behavior instead of adding a new DetectedIssue completionStatus element.
